main.description: The app's window (notes, meetings, stickies, settings): its commands and events, dragging by the title strip, closing itself when setup is done, and naming itself.

overlay.description: The overlay: the app's commands and events from the native voice code. It never drags or closes itself.

sticky.description: A sticky's window: the app's commands, dragging by its colour bar, closing itself, and its look menu as a native menu (popped from the page, so it is never clipped by the window).
